intro.h2: No surprises, from tear-out to tile
paragraphs: Dynasty Home Improvement LLC focuses on bathroom remodeling Colchester homeowners describe as calm and well planned. One reviewer said David verified the placement of railings, cabinets, fixtures and tile with them along the way, so there were no surprises, and kept the house clean the whole time.

Bathrooms here often go deeper than new tile. One first-floor bathroom needed the old tile removed and a section of subfloor replaced before the new tile, sink and toilet went in. That couple was already planning to have David renovate their two other bathrooms. Reviewers also say he stays within the agreed budget and timing.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Colchester, and kitchens too

items.name: Full bathroom renovations
items.blurb: David plans and builds complete bathroom remodels: demolition, new tile, vanities, toilets, sinks and fixtures, grab bars and railings. Reviewers say he checks each placement with you before it is set and keeps the rest of the house clean while the work is going on.

image.alt: Bathroom with double white vessel sinks, round mirrors, black faucets, white wainscoting and a glass shower with a grab bar

items.name: Tile showers
items.blurb: Walk-in showers with large-format wall tile, pebble floors and recessed niches are part of their recent work. The shower shown here pairs white marble-look tile with a pebble floor, a matching pebble niche and a sliding glass door.

image.alt: Shower with white marble-look tile walls, pebble floor, pebble niche and chrome handheld shower

items.name: Subfloor and tile floor repair
items.blurb: Old bathrooms often hide damage. On one first-floor bathroom the crew removed the old tile, replaced a section of the subfloor, then laid new tile and replaced the sink, toilet and fixtures. Getting the base right first is what makes new tile last.

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: One Google review highlight says simply that Dave remodeled their bathroom and their kitchen. Their photos show a white shaker kitchen with marble-look countertops, a sink under the window and a herringbone tile backsplash. Their social pages also list flooring among their services.

image.alt: White shaker kitchen with marble-look countertops, sink under a window, herringbone backsplash and stainless refrigerator

items.name: Backsplashes, range and vent updates
items.blurb: Smaller kitchen jobs are welcome. One customer had a downdraft range swapped for a conventional double oven range, with a new vent above, rerouted venting, moved and added outlets, and new wallboard and finishing. David fit that job in between larger projects.

image.alt: Herringbone white tile backsplash panel above a black cooktop framed by subway tile

items.title: Checked with you at every step
items.text: A reviewer said David verified the placement of railings, cabinets, fixtures and tile along the way to ensure no surprises. You see decisions before they are permanent.

items.title: On budget and on time
items.text: Google reviewers say he stays within the agreed budget and timing, and punctual and trustworthy are among the most common words in their 18 five-star reviews.

items.title: Fast replies
items.text: Customers say David responds quickly to any communication, is easy to work with and follows through on what was promised. You are not left wondering what is happening.

items.title: Clean, careful crew
items.text: Reviewers mention a crew that kept the house clean and did beautiful finishing work. One called the team very professional and proud of a job well done.

about.h2: About David and Dynasty Home Improvement
about.text: Dynasty Home Improvement LLC is a bathroom remodeler based on Windham Ave in Colchester, Connecticut. Customers deal directly with David, who plans the job, leads his crew and keeps in touch from start to finish. Reviewers describe him as multi-talented, prompt and attentive to their wishes. The work covers full bathroom renovations, tile showers, subfloor repair, kitchen remodels and smaller kitchen updates like range and vent swaps. Several clients come back for more rooms, and the company replies to its Google reviews, thanking customers for their business.
about.owner_role: Runs the jobs and the crew (named in every captured review; called Dave in one); last name not published

steps.title: Call David
steps.text: Call (860) 710-4602, Monday to Friday between 8 AM and 5 PM, and describe the bathroom or kitchen work you want done.

steps.title: Plan the job
steps.text: David looks at the room and plans the renovation with you, agreeing on the budget and timing before work starts.

steps.title: Confirm placements
steps.text: As work goes on, he verifies the placement of railings, cabinets, fixtures and tile with you so there are no surprises.

steps.title: Build and finish
steps.text: The crew handles demolition, subfloor repair, tile, fixtures and finishing, and keeps the house clean throughout the job.

steps.title: Final look
steps.text: Walk through the finished room with David. Reviewers say he follows through with what was promised.

items.name: Brian M.
items.text: David was excellent in planning and executing the bathroom renovation and kept us informed along the way verifying placement of railings, cabinets, fixtures, and tiling to ensure no surprises and kept our house clean. He is a multi-talented professional.

items.name: Susan K.
items.text: We are very happy with David's renovation of our first floor bathroom. The job involved removal of the old tile, replacement of a section of the sub-floor, installation of new tile, and replacement of our old sink, toilet and their fixtures. All were very well done. Also, David was prompt and always attentive to our wishes. It was a pleasure to work with him. We will hire David to renovate our two other bathrooms next year and we do not hesitate recommending him for his work.

This included installing new above the range vent, moving and replacing old venting, and moving and adding electrical outlets. He was very accomodating to work our project in between larger ones. David is easy to work with, good at communicating, and follows  through with what was promised. His crew did a beautiful job on the sheet work and finishing steps. All are very professional and take pride in a job well done.

service_area.text: Dynasty Home Improvement LLC works from 7A Windham Ave, Colchester, CT 06415. Colchester is the town on its Google profile and the town tied to its Facebook project posts. If you are planning a bathroom remodel, a tile shower or a kitchen update in or near Colchester, call (860) 710-4602 on a weekday to check whether your home fits David's schedule.

items.q: What if my bathroom floor is damaged under the tile?
items.a: That is work David has handled. On one first-floor bathroom the crew removed the old tile, replaced a section of the subfloor, then installed new tile and replaced the sink, toilet and fixtures. If the floor feels soft or uneven, mention it when you call so it can be checked.

items.q: Will I know what is going on during the job?
items.a: Yes. A reviewer said David kept them informed along the way, verifying the placement of railings, cabinets, fixtures and tile to ensure no surprises. Other reviewers say he responds quickly to any communication and is good at communicating throughout the project.

items.q: Do you take on small jobs?
items.a: Yes. One customer had a downdraft range replaced with a conventional range, including a new vent hood, rerouted venting and moved outlets. She said David was very accommodating in fitting her project in between larger ones. Call and describe the job to see when it can be scheduled.

items.q: Do you remodel kitchens as well?
items.a: Yes. A Google review highlight says Dave remodeled their bathroom and their kitchen, and their photos include a white shaker kitchen with marble-look counters, a sink under the window and a herringbone backsplash. Bathrooms are the main specialty, but kitchen work is part of what they do.

Google lists Dynasty Home Improvement LLC as open Monday to Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM, and closed on Saturday and Sunday. Call (860) 710-4602 during those hours, or send an email with photos of your bathroom and a short description of what you want changed.
